visualCharacteristics.purpose: full-bleed photo with an overlapping white content box and CTA
visualCharacteristics.description: Heading 'Next Adventures' with yellow underline, then a full-bleed photo with an overlapping white content box (h2, description, yellow 'See Trip' CTA), same look as carousel slides.

contentPattern.structure: row 1 image; row 2 heading, description and CTA link

usage: Static promotional teaser for a single trip or story.
reuseGuidance: Use for a single non-rotating image + boxed text teaser; matches the carousel-hero slide look. Use carousel-hero for multiple rotating slides.
